reports.title: Kratos Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: Also importantly, we reported an Adjusted EBITDA profit and margin in the third quarter of $50.9 million or 10.8 percent, demonstrating leverage of the business as production quantities increase and as Kratos continues to scale, which we expect to continue into 2027.”

DeMarco continued, “We have provided our initial full fiscal year 2027 financial forecast, including revenue of $2.1 to $2.2 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $230 to $240 million, reflecting growth of approximately 18 percent to 22 percent over our current increased 2026 financial guidance revenue range with forecasted increased 2027 margins, consistent with our previous expectations.
